text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Spe and Grass are so tough to beat!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In addition to Special Week and Grass
Wonder,
many other high-profile racers
participated in this
year's Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's amazing that Haru Urara was even
able to
enter!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I did! Usually that's enough, but...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hm... I'm not sure, but I feel... strange.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I did my best and had fun, but... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems confused by her emotions.
She's truly
at a loss for words.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, her desire to run has been
fueling her, but other than that, nothing
drives her to race. This may be my
chance to give her a clear and fixed
goal!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Try again? In the Arima Kinen?
choice_data_list: If you run it one more time, you m...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That's it! Running always helps me
think!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I wanna enter the Arima Kinen
again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure her loss is what's eating Haru
Urara up
inside.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So I decide to train her for another year
and have
her enter the Arima Kinen
again with a refreshed
mindset.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In order for her to qualify for the Arima
Kinen, we'll have to improve her graded
race results,
popularity, and running
abilities.
choice_data_list: Then we've got to win a graded race.
Then we've got to win a graded rac...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Sooo... I have to get good grades and
run hard?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Heehee. I can't wait for next year's
Arima
Kinen! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I'll believe in Haru Urara's resolve.
With this,
Haru Urara's classic year
comes to an end.
